characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle, during an Activation Roll, it allows a player to re-roll one die result. Additionally, a Mage with the Battle Staff attached to a unit always grants +3 attacks instead of +1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Move range of the Mage wearing the Enchanted Shoes equals 30 cm instead of 20 cm. Reusable item.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Mage is to be eliminated from the battle by a foe, he may roll a D6. A score of 5 or less means that the breastplate saved the Mage from death. The Mage must then attach to a friendly unit within 30 cm.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Mage can use the Ring of Spells to cast any one spell from the ones he did not buy.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Roll a D6. Move and charge ranges of the enemy units are decreased by the obtained number.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Mage who got touched by the enemy unit may immediately roll 6D6. Each score of 4 or less means that the enemy unit is dealt 1 Wound with no saves permitted. The Mage is allowed to touch the enemy unit on purpose during his move, however, if the unit survives, it can still take a test for the Mage’s death.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During an enemy Champion’s ability test, the Mage can shatter the result obtained by the Champion. The shattered die counts as a failed test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Before the battle, it allows the Mage to buy a third spell.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Target unit (but not single model) with Creature can be assigned one prayer until the end of the cycle, after taking the successful Prayer Test (LD=8). Item cannot be used by the Sheol-morg army.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The ranges of all spells cast by the Mage are 10 cm greater. Reusable item.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the opponent won the Initiative Test, you may use this item. Remove an Action Die from target enemy unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Before the battle, the Mage can buy up to three magic items instead of two thanks to the Magical Familiar. The Magical Familiar does not count to the limit of magic items.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Roll a D6 before target enemy unit’s attacks. The enemy unit will have to remove all results obtained in the WS Test and the Wound Test that show the same number as your result. If your result is 5 or 6, the item is treated as not used and can be used (even in this cycle) during another fight of any unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Target enemy unit with WS 3 or greater gets -1 to WS.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Target unit gets +1 to S.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Modify the result in the Magic Test performed by the owner by 2.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Mage is attached to a charging unit, he may use the Crown of Damnation before the unit attacks. The charged enemy unit (but not single model) must immediately take Panic Tests for 4 bases. If the enemy unit (but not single model) has Fearless or Immunity, it cannot use these abilities until the end of the cycle, and its Cold Blood Tests are treated as failed.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During one of your Activation Rolls, you can re-roll one die.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The player can re-roll one Initiative Test with a +2 modifier.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Mage may cast another spell in the cycle, but it cannot be the same as the first spell.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Every enemy unit within 20 cm of the Mage must take a D6 test. A score of 2 or less means the enemy unit is dealt 2 Wounds with no saves permitted.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If an enemy Mage used a spell or an item other than Dispel, you may roll a D6. A score of 5 or less means that the spell or item was dispelled and did not work. A score of 1 means that the Dispel did not lose its power and the Mage will be able to use it again.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Mage can teleport up to 40 cm during its activation.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Target unit within 20 cm of the Mage must re-roll all failed or successful hits in the Weapon Skill Test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Use this item to support target unit within 20 cm of the Mage. Each score of 1 in the Wound Test performed by the chosen unit deals additional 1 Wound.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When attached to a unit, the General supports it with 7 attacks instead of 6.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The General’s pool of orders is increased by 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When touched by an enemy unit, the General dies only on a roll of 1. If the General survives, he must attach to a friendly unit within 30 cm.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The General’s range of issuing orders is increased by 10 cm.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When attached to a unit, the General allows it to re-roll 3 failed results in the Weapon Skill Test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If an enemy unit (but not a single model) was dealt a Wound by a unit to which the General with this artefact is attached, the wounded enemy base is removed. When attacking a single model, the unit supported by the General with this artefact may re-roll up to 6 results in the Wound Test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: An enemy unit attacking a unit to which the General with this artefact is attached loses 2 dice from the pool of attacks, or 4 dice if it has Fearless.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When attached to a unit, the General allows it to re-roll 4 failed results in the Wound Test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When attached to a unit, the General allows it to re-roll all 6s in the Weapon Skill Test made against the enemy unit that has Fearless or has a General or a Champion attached.
